[b][i][u]THIS IS THE DARKEST DAY IN THE HISTORY OF MAQAMISTAN[/u][/i].[/b]

In the name of God, the Most Merciful, Most Compassionate.

Today, the father of our nation has been taken from us. Jose Velazquez, the Guide of the Revolution, President for Life of the People's Islamic Republic of Maqamistan, and the architect of our freedom, has returned to his Creator.

He fell as a martyr this afternoon, killed by a cowardly assassin driven by the poison of racist hatred during the Festival Unity in Maqam Dar-as-Salam. Akhi Velazquez's final words have been recorded as "Te perdono, cabrón" ("I forgive you, you bastard.")

The enemies of our unity believe this act of terror will divide our brothers and sisters of many ethnicities and even religions. They are wrong. The Republic stands unshakeable. The blood of our founder will only water the roots of our Just Order.

By order of Her Excellency Prime Minister Satanay Pasht and the Maqami Majlis, a forty-day period of national mourning begins immediately. The military and state police have been mobilized to ensure the peace and security of the Republic. All flags are to be lowered to half-mast. We respect the same respect and solidarity from our allies.

To God we belong and to Him we shall return.

May God grant him the highest ranks in paradise, and may God protect Maqamistan.

----

Akhi Velazquez was killed by Shabbabist terrorists. Shabbabism is a large cult that is banned in Maqamistan. Maqamistan is a multiethnic country, but Shabbabism is a radical group who believes in a God of Wrath called "Shabbab" and holds the view that "Maqamistan is for Arabs". Shabbabists believe in the superiority of their race and hate all other races, they also hate all other religions, such as Islam or Christianity. Most Arabs don't support Shabbabism, but a tiny minority does.

What will happen next is unclear, but people have already started mourning the leader. Whether the country will be able to maintain unity remains unclear. There are rumors that some groups have started arming themselves...

[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP

[spoiler=asd]The Declaration

The false idol has fallen. The Latin usurper dog is dead.

For nearly half a century, the sacred land of Maqamistan has been defiled by the disease of so-called 'Just Order Socialism.' The nations of the world watched as they forced sick ideologies such as democracy on us.

That ends today. We declare the total dissolution of the Peoples Islamic Republic. In its place rises the True Shabbabist State of Maqamistan.

The death of the Latin dog is only the beginning. To the Muslim infidels, the Circassian traitors, the Latin occupiers, and the socialist traitors who have stolen our birthright: the time of your false equality is over. You will obey the natural order and submit to the Promised Light, or you will be exterminated. Every enemy of our righteous state will be put to the sword.

To the global powers, and all true enemies of the socialist rot: we speak directly to you. We share a common enemy. The socialist regime that locked you out of our markets and seized our national wealth is bleeding. Recognize the Shabbabist State, and the vast resources, ports, and trade routes of Maqamistan will be yours to access.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Emergency Broadcast][b][i][u]Emergency Broadcast[/u][/i][/b]

This is an emergency broadcast from the Ministry of Interior.

In the wake of the martyrdom of our founding father, a wave of cowardly terrorist attacks has struck our beloved nation. Many lives were lost. Heretical extremists have temporarily breached several broadcasting stations, falsely proclaiming the establishment of an illegitimate, supremacist state they call 'Shabbabist Maqamistan.'

The honest people of Maqamistan know that these traitors have violeted Islamic law, betrayed the Just Order, and as tried to hurt the sacred brotherhood of our Arab, Circassian, Latin, and other peoples. They are criminals, murderers, and heretics.

Prime Minister Satanay Pasht has enacted immediate martial law across all provinces. The Maqami Armed Forces have been deployed with full authorization to neutralize any terrorist elements. All borders, ports, and airspace are sealed. A nationwide curfew is in effect immediately.

God protects the Republic.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Large Natural Gas Reserves Discovered off the Coast of Wellassona]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Thursday, 16 March 2028[/i]

Earlier this week, The Department of Energy announced that it had discovered new natural gas reserves in Kemder, just north of the city of Buzusso, in the far northwest of the country. The reserves, which amount to nearly 30 trillion cubic metres, is considered monumental, as it increases Wellassona's known gas reserves by almost 40%. They were discovered after workers fixing undersea cables in the area stumbled upon a crack near the wires in which gas was detected. 

Prime Minister Danil Sokolova is optimistic about the findings, saying [i]"This is a monumental find. With this new gas, we shall be able to safely power our nation for the next generations".[/i] Sokolova also expressed the need to safely managed the new gas: [i]"Of course, we must be responsible in its extraction to make sure not to cause unwanted environmental damage, thus it is our main priority to ensure the safe management of the new reserves,"[/i] he said when asked about the possible environmental impact of the discovery.

Other officials also expressed excitement at the news. Energy Minister Varlam Defoov called the findings [i]"The greatest discovery of modern Wellassona, and of perhaps Elseyr"[/i]. Danil Dovlikov, CEO of Wellassona's state-owned energy company Gazent-Ris, stated that the discovery was [i]"glorious,"[/i] and that [i]"with it, Wellassona will enter a new age."[/i] Kemder Premier Karina Lagounov was also supportive, saying [i]"The new discovery is just what we need to ensure energy independence."[/i]

Opposition has arisen based on the discovery of the gas reserves. Irineya Kolesnika, Secretary of Agriculture and Head of the Green Party, voiced some concerns. Regarding the findings, she said, [i]"I personally believe that Wellassona should focus on more renewable sources, such as solar or wind power, instead of environment-harming methods such as gas."[/i] Nevertheless, she still supported the PM, adding that she [i]"trusts Mr. Sokolova to make the right decision on the gas, and to be responsible regarding the dangers it might pose."[/i]

The Otvragivod Borz, Wellassona's main stock exchange, reacted positively to the announcement, with the Borzdeks (The main Stock Market Index) rising 0.7%. The Government has stated it is open to any nations wishing to make deals regarding the new gas reserves. 

[/spoiler]
